s: Din hakana beyom tob ubo l"b seipim. (En tzadin dagim min habbebarin beyom tob, shehare epshar letzudan meereb yom tob). Dagim hammekunnasim babbebarim meereb yom tob — asur littol mehem beyom tob, apillu hu bebar qatan meod beinyan sheen tzarik lebaqqesh tachbulot kede letzudan al yede perisat maakal o al yede metzuda ella yakol letopsan beyado beqal. Veap al pi shehatztzad beshabbat mibbebar qatan kazeh patur lepi sheenah niqret tzida, mikkol maqom middibre soperim asur littol mehem apillu letzorek akilat yom tob, mippene shehem muqtzin, kevan shehem mekussin min haayin veen dato alehem min hassetam, ella im ken hekin otam meereb yom tob, kegon shehiknisam leargaz male mayim, o shessakar ammat hammayim biknisa ubitzia meereb yom tob, dekevan sheasa bahem maaseh meereb yom tob kede lehazminam — en zeh muqtzeh, umuttar letzudan beyom tob im hu beinyan sheeno tzarik metzuda ella yakol letopsan beyado, vaapillu eno yakol letopsan bishchiyya achat ella tzarik litroach kamma peamim ad sheyyitpos.
(Vaapillu im hu beinyan sheyyakol letopsan beqal beyado — tob lizzaher shello letzudan bimtzuda, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol).
Veim hem bebor amoq — eno tzarik lered lematta kede letopsan beyado, ella omed lemala vetopesan al yede keli.

Im beshaa shehiknis haddagim leargaz o beshaa shessakar ammat hammayim haya bedato sheepshar sheyyitztarek beyom tob lekol haddagim shebbeargaz o shebbeammat hammayim, im ken hare hukenu kol haddagim, velaken muttar libror mehem beyom tob mah shetztzarik ulehachazir hashshear lemayim, veen zeh metaltel mah sheeno rauy lo, kevan shekkebar hukenu kullam qodem yom tob letzorek yom tob. Abal im beshaa shehiknis haddagim leargaz o leammat hammayim haya yodea shebbevadday lo yitztarek beyom tob lekol haddagim ella lemiqtzatan, im ken hare lo hukenu ella otam sheyyitztarek lahem beyom tob, velaken asur libror mehem beyom tob mah shetztzarik lo ulehachazir lemayim hammotar, shehare hu metaltel muqtzeh, ella tzarik liqqach veleekol kol sheyyaaleh beyado, ben tob uben ra.

Kol sheasur leoklo beyom tob mippene shehu muqtzeh, ben behema ben chayya vaop ben dagim — en mashqin otan beyom tob veen notenim lipnehem mezonot, shemma yishkach veyiqqachem leekol. Bammeh debarim amurim? Lipnehem mammash, abal berachoq mehem qetzat muttar litten mezonot o mayim vehen baim veokelim veshotim, dekevan shehitzrikuhu leharchiq mehem qetzat — yesh lo hekker, velo yishkach velo yabo liqqach otan.

Kol dabar sheen rauy laakila, kegon behemot temeim veopot temeim, kevan sheen lachush shemma yishkach veyiqqachem leekol, leken muttar litten mezonot lipnehem mammash ulehashqotan im mezonotan alayv, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"d ayyen sham.
Kol dabar sheasur leoklo beyom tob o lehishtammesh bo mippene shehu muqtzeh — asur letaltelo.

Kol dabar shehu sapeq im hu muqtzeh o eno muqtzeh, kegon metzudot chayya opot vedagim shehayu perusot meereb yom tob ulemachar motze bahem veeno yodea im nitztzod hayyom o etmol — asurim ben baakila ben betiltul ad haereb, ben shehayyom hu yom tob rishon ben shehu yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, lepi shehammuqtzeh hu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin", lepikak holekin bispeqo lehachamir (ayyen simman tqt"v). Veim matza hammetzuda mequlqelet meereb yom tob — beyadua shennitztzod bah meereb yom tob, ulepikak nitqalqela hammetzuda, mechamat shehaddabar shennitztzod mitrappeq umitnatteq latzet.

Vaapillu im yadua shennitztzod beyom tob — eno asur ella beyom tob atzmo, abal lemotzae yom tob muttar miyyad veen tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, kevan shello naasa meleket issur beyom tob, shehare meelayv nitztzod al yede metzudot happerusot meereb yom tob. Abal im chal shabbat bemotzae yom tob — asur baakila ubetiltul ad motzae shabbat kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqt"v. Vaapillu baggaluyyot sheosin shene yamim tobim, im nitztzod barishon — muttar bashsheni miyyad, chutz mishshene yamim tobim shel rosh hashshana, shehen qedushsha achat vehen keyom echad arok, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman t"r, ayyen simman tqt"v.

Avvazim vetarnegolim veyonim shebbabbayit, veken shear opot shehen babbayit, kevan shehen bain likluban laereb — hare enam mechussarin tzida, vehatztzad otan beshabbat apillu chutz likluban patur. Ulepikak muttar letzudan lekattechilla beyom tob letzorek akila, apillu i epshar letopsan ella al yede metzuda, abal kesheeno tzarik leoklan — asur letzudan beyom tob kemo beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"v.

Abal avvazin vetarnegolim veyonim sheqqana mechadash vaadayin lo hurgelu bebeto veenan bain likluban laereb — dinan kishar kol chayya vaop sheenan bene tarbut, veim hen mechussarin tzida beinyan shehatztzad otam beshabbat chayyab al derek shennitbaer besimman shy"v — asur letzudan beyom tob apillu letzorek akila. Veim enan mechussarin tzida, kegon chayya shenniknesa meereb yom tob lebebar qatan kol kak beinyan sheyyekolin latzud otah bishchiyya achat, veken op shenniknas meereb yom tob lebayit qatan o bebar qatan meqoreh beinyan sheyyakol letopso bishchiyya achat, veken tzippor deror shenniknas meereb yom tob lemigdal, shekkol ellu kebar nitztzodin veomedin hen, ap al pi shebbeshabbat asur letzudan middibre soperim, mikkol maqom beyom tob mishshum simchat yom tob hittiru letzudan letzorek akila apillu lo yada bahen meereb yom tob, veen bahem mishshum muqtzeh.

Ayyal o tzebi sheqqinnenu bepardes hassamuk lair betok shibim amma ved' tepachim veyaledu bo oparim vaadayin hen qetannim sheenam tzerikim tzida — muttar liqqach otam beyom tob ap al pi shello zimmen otam meereb yom tob, veen bahen mishshum muqtzeh, kevan sheroeh otam bekol yom vedato alehem — hare hu keillu zimmen otam. Abal im happardes hu chutz mishshibim amma ved' tepachim — vadday en dato alehem letzorek yom tob, veasur liqqach mehen beyom tob ella im ken zimmen otam meereb yom tob.

Kol shemmechussar tzida beinyan shehatztzad oto beshabbat chayyab, apillu zimmen oto meereb yom tob vedato alayv — en moil kelum, veasur liqqach oto beyom tob apillu nitztzod meelayv beyom tob, kevan shebben hashshemashot haya mechussar tzida — hare zeh muqtzeh.

Kol sheeno mechussar tzida, kegon chayya vaop shehen bene tarbut ugedelin bebeto shel adam, o shekkebar nitztzodu meereb yom tob lemaqom sheen tzarik letzudan mishsham al yede metzuda o tachbulot acherot — muttar liqqach otan beyom tob apillu lo zimmen otam meereb yom tob, lepi shemmin hassetam hen omedin laakila, ella im ken haya dato beberur alehem legaddel veladot o legaddel betzim, sheaz hen tzerikim zimmun meereb yom tob letzorek yom tob ledibre haoserin muqtzeh beyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h.

Kol ellu sheen tzarik lezammen otam meereb yom tob — muttar libror mehem beyom tob littol mah shetztzarik lo vehutab beenayv, umah shello hutab beenayv yachazir limqomo. Veap al pi shehu metaltel mah sheen tzarik leoklo beyom tob — en bekak kelum, kevan sheeno muqtzeh kelal. Umikkol maqom, kol yere shamayim yibror meereb yom tob kol mah sheyyitztarek leyom tob, kede shello yitztarek litroach beyom tob.

Yone shobak veyone aliyya, dehaynu yone hepqer, shebbaim umeqannenim beshobak ubaaliyya, veken tzipporim sheqqinnenu bitpichim (perush kele cheres habbenuyim bekotel leqannen bahem haopot), ap al pi shehen bain likluban laereb, mikkol maqom kevan sheasuyin lehishshamet velibroach mippene bene adam uborechin ad qinnan vetzarik laalot acharehen, vegam sham nishmatin mimmennu veyoredin veen noach letopsan apillu bikluban, lepikak hatztzad otam beshabbat apillu mikkeluban chayyab, velaken asur letzudan beyom tob apillu letzorek akila, vaapillu zimmen otam meereb yom tob — en moil kelum. Vaapillu im noach letopsan — asur, kevan sheen mezonotam aleka lo chashibi kimzumman.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bigdolim sheyyekolin liproach heteb, ap al pi sheen yekolin liproach chutz lattechum, mikkol maqom kevan shehem yekolin libroach mippene bene adam — hare hen mechussarin tzida, ulepikak asur letzudan beyom tob. Abal qetannim sheen maprichin ella meat veen yekolim libroach mippene bene adam — en bahem issur tzida, shekkebar hen nitztzodim veomedim. Abal yesh bahen mishshum muqtzeh, shehare enan birshuto shel adam veenan mukanin lo, ulepikak tzarik lezammen otam meereb yom tob.

Veketzad hu hazzimmun? Omed meereb yom tob uborer mehen mah sheyyitztarek lo beyom tob, o omed bedato kamma yitztarek beyom tob, veoseh bahen simman o tebiat ayin sheyyakkirem lemachar, veyomar: "ellu ani notel lemachar". Abal im lo barar meereb yom tob, veamar setam: "mikkan ani notel lemachar" — en hazmana zo moelet kelum, veasur littol mehem beyom tob. Vaapillu im lo yirtzeh libror kelum ella rotzeh littol min habba leyado hen kechusha hen shemena — asur, gezera shemma yibror hashshemenot min hakkechushot veyittol et hashshemenot veyanniach et hakkechushot, venimtza tiltel et hakkechushot shehen muqtzeh, shehare lo haya bedato lehazmin ella mah sheyyokal beyom tob.

Vaapillu im zimmen et kol hayyonim shebbashshobak, veamar: "et kullam ani notel lemachar", veyodea shebbevadday lo yokal et kullam beyom tob, veken im amar: "ellu shene zugim ani notel lemachar", veyodea shebbevadday lo yokal beyom tob ella zug echad — en hazmanato moelet kelum leotam shello yokal mehem beyom tob, vahare hem nisharim muqtzeh, ulepikak asur liqqach apillu perida achat min hayyonim shezzimmen behazmana zo. Vaapillu rotzeh littol min habba leyado — asur, gezera shemma yibror. Abal im eno yodea shebbevadday lo yokal min kol hayyonim shezzimmen, ap al pi sheen barur lo shebbevadday yokal mikkol mah shezzimmen, mikkol maqom, kevan sheepshar sheyyokal mikkullam — moelet hazmanato lekol mah shezzimmen, ulepikak muttar libror mehem beyom tob mah shetztzarik lo ulehanniach hashshear, veap al pi shemmetaltel hashshear beyado — en bekak kelum, shehare enam muqtzeh kelal.

Zimmen shene yonim umatza shelosha veeno makkir otam shezzimmen — kullam asurim mippene echad sheeno mezumman shennitareb bahem, veeno mitbattel berob, mippene shehu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin". Veim neekal echad mehen o neebad o napal layyam — hare hashshenayim hannisharim muttarim, veal derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea simman q"y, ayyen sham.

Zimmen yonim shechorim beqen echad ulebanim beqen sheetzlo ulemachar matza lebanim bimqom shechorim ushechorim bimqom lebanim, im hen yekolin liproach meat — kullam asurim, sheanu chosheshim shemma otam shezzimmen parechu vehaleku lahem veellu acherim hen shebbau mimmaqom acher lekan. Abal im zimmen beqen echad shechorim betzad zeh ulebanim betzad zeh umatza shechorim bimqom lebanim ulebanim bimqom shechorim — hare hem muttarim, sheanu tolin lomar shehen hen harishonim ella shehechelipu meqoman.

Im beshaa shezzimmen et hayyonim hayu betok haqqen ulemachar matza otam al petach haqqen — muttarim, ap al pi sheeno motzean bimqoman, hare hizmin mah sheyyihyu bekol haqqen. Abal im metzaan lipne haqqen, im hen yekolin liproach meat — asurim, sheanu chosheshin shemma ellu shehizmin parechu vehaleku lahem veellu hen acherim shebbau mimmaqom acher lekan. Abal im en hayyonim shehizmin yekolim liproach apillu meat, ella yekolin ledaddot meat meat, im lo haya etmol qinnim acherim shel yonim tok chamishshim amma sebibot zeh haqqen shehizmin hayyonim shebbo — hare ellu hayyonim shemmetzaan lipne haqqen muttarim, kevan sheenan yekolin ella ledaddot, vekal hamdaddeh eno medaddeh yoter min chamishshim amma, veim ken ellu hayyonim bevadday lo bau mimmaqom acher ella hen hen hayyonim shehizmin. Vaapillu yesh qinnim acherim shel yonim sebibot zeh haqqen ella shehen beqeren zavit beinyan shei epshar lirotam mimmaqom shellipne zeh haqqen shemmatza bo hayyonim shezzimmen — hare ellu muttarim, lepi shekkol hamdaddeh eno medaddeh ella ad maqom sheyyakol lirot mishsham et qinno sheyyatza mimmennu. Abal im etmol beshaa shezzimmen otam hayu qinnim acherim shel yonim muqtzim tok chamishshim amma sebibot zeh haqqen, ubeyom tob beshaa shemmatza et hayyonim shezzimmen lipne haqqen lo matza minyan yonim shel muqtzeh shebbeqinnim acherim kemo shehaya minyanam etmol — yesh lachush shemma hayyonim shezzimmen haleku lahem veellu shellipne haqqen hen yonim muqtzim shehayu medaddin veholekin ad shehiggiu ad lipne zeh haqqen, ulepikak hem asurim.

Veken haddin im zimmen lebanim beqen echad ushechorim beqen sheetzlo ulemachar matza shechorim bimqom lebanim ulebanim bimqom shechorim, im en yekolim liproach ella ledaddot vetok chamishshim amma sebibot ellu haqqinnim en sham qinnim acherim shel yonim sheyyihyeh epshar lirotam mittok haqqinnim shezzimmen — hare ellu hayyonim shezzimmen muttarim, mittaam shennitbaer.

Im zimmen shelosha yonim beqen echad ulemachar lo matza beoto haqqen raq shenayim, apillu yesh sebibot zeh haqqen qinnim shel yonim acherim, veyesh lachush shemma harishonim haleku lahem veellu hashshenayim hen shel qinnim hammuqtzim — ap al pi ken hen muttarim, lepi sheanu tolin shehashshelishi halak lo vehannisharim hen otam shezzimmen. Vaapillu im beshaa shezzimmen otam qashar et sheloshtan zeh bazeh ulemachar lo matza raq shenayim qeshurim zeh bazeh o muttarin zeh mizzeh — hare ellu muttarin, lepi shedderek habbaale chayyim lehitpareq ulehinnateq miqqeshiratam. Vaapillu lo zimmen ella shenayim beqen echad uqesharan zeh bazeh ulemachar matza shelosha qeshurin zeh bazeh — hare kullam muttarim, shebbevadday adam qesharan zeh bazeh umin hassetam lo qesharan beyom tob ella beereb yom tob, veim ken hare kol hashshelosha mukanin meereb yom tob al yede qeshira zo. Abal im lemachar matza shelosha meporadin zeh mizzeh — hare kullan asurin, shehare yesh kan echad shello zimmen oto meereb yom tob, vekevan sheeno makkiro kullam asurim. Veim matza shenayim qeshurin zeh bazeh vehashshelishi eno qashur — hashshenayim haqqeshurin muttarim, sheanu omerim shehen hen otan shezzimmen, vehashshelishi shello zimmeno meereb yom tob — asur.

Kol dabar shehu muqtzeh eno asur ella im ken bealayv hiqtzu oto vehissichu datam mimmennu, abal im bealayv lo hissichu datam mimmennu — eno niqra muqtzeh kelal, velaken nokri shehebi doron leyisrael bene yona qetannim sheenam tzerikim tzida mishshobakot sheyyesh lo betok hattechum — muttarim, lepi sheen hannokri maqtzeh middato kelum, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"y. Abal im hem gedolim kol kak ad shetztzerikim tzida — asurim, ap al pi shello tzadan bishbil yisrael, kevan shetztzarik lebaqqesh tachbulot kede letopsan — en moil kelum mah sheen hannokri maqtzeh dato mehen, lepi sheen zeh haddabar taluy bedato, shemma lo yukal letopsan.

Habbodeq behema beyom tob yibdeqenna bemaqom sheyyehe beepshar lehannichah sham im tihyeh terepa, lepi sheasur letaltelah keshettimmatze terepa mimmaqom zeh lemaqom acher. Veken chakam hammoreh horaa bedabar sheyyehe asur letaltelo im yeaser — lo yoreh ad sheyyannichuhu miqqodem bemaqom hammeyuchad lo, ki achar sheyyeesor yehe asur letaltelo.

Hashshochet behema beyom tob — muttar lehapshitah qodem habbediqa, veen chosheshin shemma timmatze terepa, lepi shemmaamidin otah bechezqat hetter, sherob behemot hen kesherot. Vetob lo sheyyapshitenna qodem bediqa, sheim yibdoq vetimmatze terepa — lo yehe rashshay lehapshitah, shehare hu oseh melaka gemura shello letzorek akila.

Im nimtzet terepa — asur letaltelah apillu mechamma letzel ledibre haoserim nolad beyom tob, shehare etmol hayeta omedet umukenet laakilat adam veakshav shennitrepa omedet lakkelabim vahare zeh nolad, ukebar nitbaer besimman ttz"h sheyyesh lehachamir veleesor nolad beyom tob.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bedorot harishonim shello hayu terepot metzuyin, abal bizman hazzeh sheanu machamirin harbeh chumrot bitrepot, ulepikak hatterepot metzuyin meod, veim neesor letaltel hatterepa mechamma letzal kede shello tisrach yimmana velo yishchot kelal, venimtza memaet besimchat yom tob, lepikak hittiru lo letaltelah mechamma letzel.

Veken mittaam zeh hittiru lo lemokrah lenokri al derek sheyyitbaer bimkira leyisrael, dehaynu shello yittol damim, velo yishqol, velo yizkor lo sekum damim. Veim eno maamino — yiqqach mimmennu mashkon.

Veken mittaam zeh hittiru limkor lenokri cheleq haachorayim apillu mibbehema keshera bemaqom sheen menaqqer matzuy. Veim epshar lehatznia ad leachar yom tob beinyan shello yasriach — asur limkor lenokri terepa o achorayim. Veim shechatah ereb yom tob vehaya lo shahut limkor lenokri qodem yom tob — asur limkor beyom tob apillu i epshar lishmor shello yasriach, shello hittiru limkor ella kede shello yimmana millishchot im neesor lo limkor, abal keshennishchata beereb yom tob vehaya lo shahut limkor qodem yom tob, ap im neesor lo limkor beyom tob — lo yimmana millishchot bishbil zeh, shehare epshar lo limkor qodem yom tob.

Dabar sheen hattarput matzuy bo, kegon avvazin vetarnegolim — asur letaltelo mechamma letzel im nitrap, vaapillu yasriach bevadday. Veken asur lemokro lenokri, kevan sheen hattarput matzuy bo — lo yimmana millishchot bishbil kak.
